AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safe Handling of Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safe Handling of Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safe Handling of Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safe Handling of Animals.

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Field Management Practices? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Field Management Practices.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Field Management Practices.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Field Management Practices.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Field Management Practices.

17. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.

21. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Establishing Agricultural Enterprise and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing Agricultural Produce 3.5 Composting Techniques Page 15 of 62 1 STRAND  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing agricultural produce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Composting Techniques Page 15 of 62 1 STRAND 1.0: CROP PRODUCTION and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Composting Techniques and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Agricultural Land and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of soil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Land Preparation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
